Name: Zentide
Description:
"Building accessible and scalable bio-solutions for a greener future."

Zentide is transforming the future of agriculture by harnessing tropical seaweed to create high-performance bio-solutions. Modern farming faces a critical challenge—degraded soils, excessive reliance on synthetic fertilizers, and rising emissions. By providing natural, scalable alternatives, we help farmers restore soil health, reduce input costs, and lower greenhouse gas emissions, all while improving long-term agricultural resilience.

Beyond farming, seaweed cultivation offers a powerful social and environmental impact. We work alongside coastal communities, creating sustainable livelihoods for seaweed farmers and strengthening local economies. As one of the world’s most effective carbon sinks, seaweed absorbs CO2, enhances marine ecosystems, and prevents agricultural runoff, making it a vital solution in the fight against climate change.

Backed by Wavemaker Impact, Southeast Asia’s leading climate-tech venture builder, Zentide is committed to scaling real solutions that drive sustainability and economic growth. Our goal is to transform agriculture while creating lasting positive change for farmers, communities, and the planet.

Name: AlterPacks
Description:
Alterpacks is an advanced materials start-up revolutionizing how we use nature’s leftovers.  We upcycle spent grains and agricultural by-products into high-performance, 100% plant-based materials designed to replace billions of single-use, unsustainable products.

Our proprietary technology delivers durable, home-compostable, and food-safe materials — certified by leading international agencies — that perform without compromise. We’re not just making new materials; we’re reshaping the future of consumption toward circularity and human-safe design.

Partnering with distributors, retailers, and innovators worldwide, we’re driving a bold mission: to eliminate single-use waste at scale and redefine the materials of everyday life for a healthier planet.   https://alterpacks.com/

Name: GREENLYZER
Description:
Greenlyzer is a Singapore-based deep tech company solving one of the most pressing challenges of the AI era: sustainable, reliable energy infrastructure at scale.
 
Powered by the Green Moving Grid, a new paradigm that hybridizes the conventional grid to deliver rapidly deployable, sustainable and resilient power. Our Alpha Energy System brings this vision to life through hydrogen-powered Alpha Nodes and the Alpha Grid Orchestrator, an AI-orchestrated software platform that optimizes usage and generation in real-time.
 
Our platform powers AI data centers, industrial operations, EV charging infrastructure, and remote deployments anywhere they're needed. By hybridizing distributed and traditional energy assets, we move clean energy where and when it is needed, reducing costs, enhancing resilience, and accelerating decarbonization.
 
We're not building backup power. We're building the future of energy infrastructure for intelligent systems.

Name: Lincore
Description:
Lincore, a spin-off from the National University of Singapore is redefining critical materials refining with a focus on localizing black mass refining operations, a crucial step in battery recycling. Our proprietary electro-metallurgical refining technology extracts Lithium, Nickel, Cobalt, and Manganese from black mass and processes them into low-carbon precursors that are ready to use for manufacturing new batteries needed for our energy transition journey.

At Lincore, we are developing modular, universal refining solutions that handle all Li-ion battery chemistries (LFP, NMC, LCO) black mass in one system while offering the flexibility to process all together or individual chemistries.

Name: FlueVault
Description:
FlueVault, a Singapore-based company, pioneering a Stack to Storage (StS) industrial emissions reduction technology. This innovative solution takes an emitter's flue gas directly from their flue stack and passes it through the FlueVault StS technology. The StS technology utilizes the mineral olivine within a flow-through seawater reactor to convert the CO2 into dissolved bicarbonate. This bicarbonate is then returned to the seawater, permanently storing the CO2 for over 10,000 years.

By eliminating the need for complex and expensive carbon capture, CO2 purification, and CO2 transport processes, FlueVault can reduce an industrial emitter's carbon liabilities by more than 50% and provide a simple, scalable and cost-effective approach for industrial carbon emissions reduction.

Name: FeedBank
Description:
At FeedBank, we harness the potential of Black Soldier Fly (BSF) to provide sustainable, high-quality solutions for the pet food, animal feed, and agricultural industries. - BSF Meal: High-protein powder ideal for animal and pet nutrition formulations.
- BSF Oil: A versatile lipid source for animal feed and pet products.
- BSF Frass (Organic Fertilizer): A natural soil conditioner that enriches soil health and promotes plant growth.

2. Formulated Products for Farms and Aquaculture
We develop ready-to-use, insect-based products tailored for specific applications. 
- Chicken Feed: Nutritionally balanced, insect-based formulations for poultry farms.
- Aquaculture Feed: High-quality, protein-rich feeds for sustainable fish and shrimp farming.
- Pet Food and Treats: Custom insect-based formulations for pet food brands.

3. Consulting Services
Our expertise extends to supporting businesses in building, operating, and scaling insect farming operations. Whether you're testing feasibility or expanding production, FeedBank provides the guidance and know-how to succeed.

With facilities in Indonesia and Malaysia that are FDA-registered and adhere to EU industry standards, we are committed to delivering quality, consistency, and innovation across the value chain.
Location: Singapore, Central Region, Central Region, Singapore

Name: Terraco Earth
Description:
Terraco Earth provides an innovative solution for carbon capture through the fast synthesis of Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) under ambient conditions. By leveraging a patented MOF technology, we enable efficient, scalable, and cost-effective CO2 capture without the high energy requirements typically associated with MOF production. This breakthrough approach enhances
sustainability and affordability, making MOF-based carbon capture more viable for industries looking to reduce emissions. Our service is particularly valuable for industrial emitters, energy producers, and companies pursuing carbon neutrality goals, offering a customizable and adaptable solution for diverse operational needs.

Name: Electrofuel Marine
Description:
Electrofuel Marine is an early-stage, venture-backed, deep tech start-up: Working with the Singapore Deep Tech Alliance (SDTA) to commercialize five years of breakthrough scientific research from the National University of Singapore - proving to demonstrate over 95% efficiency in molecular-level CO2, CH4, H2 and NH3 separation from exhaust gasses in real-time. Electorfuel Marine harnesses this groundbreaking science to design the world’s first modular, plug-and-play, flue-to-fuel reactor system that circularly converts greenhouse gas emissions from large container ships into usable electrofuel in real-time, without requiring any major infrastructure changes. 

Electrofuel Marine’s reactor plugs into the ship’s engine, filters out target gas, and through a continuous hydrogenation process generates eMethanol, which is then blended back into the ship’s fuel supply. Through this process, EM aims to reduce ship fuel usage and costs by 30%, cut ship emissions by 30%, and save shipping companies millions in annual fuel costs, per ship.

Name: Nexus Ecosystems

Name: NuSoil Pte Ltd
Description: NuSoil is one of the deep-tech startups under the NUS Graduate Innovation Program(GRIP), receiving seed funding from NUS and tech grant from Enterprise Singapore. Dr Tan Wee Kee and Dr Zhu Jingling are both founding members of NuSoil and creators of InnoGro, the superabsorbent hydrogel developed from the patented technology. The product is a gel like substance that is made from okara, the by-product of the soy food industry. It acts as mini-reservoir to retain water and nutrients for delivery to the plants over a longer and sustained period of time, before biodegrading, thereby helping the plants thrive and even flourish under drought conditions.
